What this note shows

Average spillover value flowing to High-Income Countries (ev_HIC) per green (and related) innovation, split by the origin of the innovation. Bars are grouped by technology field — All innovations, Green Technology, Battery Technology and AI — and within each field by the income group of the inventing/owning countries: HIC, LMIC ex China, and China. Ticking show HIC × LMIC ex China adds a fourth bar (a darker orange) for the collaboration subset — families spanning at least one high-income and one non-China LMIC; it overlaps the HIC and LMIC ex China bars (those families count in all three).

ev_HIC is the expected spillover value that an innovation ultimately delivers to inventors located in high-income countries (the group-restricted Patent-Rank social component; $ millions). A family attributed to more than one income group contributes one observation to each group it touches.

Use the Metric dropdown to switch the plotted quantity between ev (spillover value to HICs, $m), istrax (marginal returns to R&D) and avstrax (average returns to R&D); the latter two are reported as % (×100). The Universe dropdown switches between all patents and multi-country patents (families filed in at least two jurisdictions, fam_size_min2); the Status dropdown switches between all applications and granted only (granted). The current selection is stored in the page URL (e.g. ?metric=istrax&universe=multi&status=granted&collab=1), so any view can be bookmarked or shared as a link.

Metric: Universe: Status: ⬇ Download data (CSV)

Note. Bars show the mean of the selected Metric per innovation, grouped by technology field and by origin income group (HIC, LMIC ex China, China), with ±1 SEM error bars over families. Ticking show HIC × LMIC ex China adds a fourth bar (darker orange) for the collaboration subset — families with at least one high-income and one non-China LMIC attribution; those families also count in the HIC and LMIC ex China bars, so the group is an overlapping cut rather than a disjoint one. All three metrics are built on the HIC-flow spillover value ev_HIC using the standard iseapp formulas: ev = ev_HIC ($ millions); istrax = ((alpha+1)/cost)·ev_HIC·[pv ≤ 2·cost]; avstrax = (pv + ev_HIC)/cost. istrax and avstrax are reported as percentages (×100) and are defined only for families with a positive estimated R&D cost. Innovations are attributed to income groups by the country codes on the patent family (inventor and owner locations in the iseapp 2025 database); a family spanning several groups contributes once to each. The technology fields use the iseapp tech_group classification; “All innovations” imposes no technology filter. The Universe dropdown switches between all patents and multi-country patents (fam_size_min2); the Status dropdown between all applications and granted patents only (granted). The Download data (CSV) link exports the exact numbers behind the currently selected view (technology, origin group, mean and SEM).
